rules.statement: A participating Bergmahd parcel must have more than half of its parcel area above 1,200 m altitude.

conditions.description: Predominant parcel area is above 1,200 m.

result.description: Parcel can satisfy the altitude access requirement.

rules.statement: Bergmähder are extensive mowing areas above the local permanent-settlement boundary; normally they are higher than and not directly adjacent to home-farm land. For an alpine farm, they may be below the alpine establishment.

result.description: Only parcels meeting the Bergmahd definition may participate.

rules.statement: The commitment is at least four years and ends on 31 December 2028: starts in 2023, 2024 and 2025 last six, five and four years respectively.

result.description: The contractual end date is 2028-12-31.

rules.statement: Every Bergmahd must be mown across its full area and forage removed at least once in each two-year period; no more than one mowing per year is allowed. Leaving harvest on the land or mulching is not allowed.

conditions.expression: mowing_count_last_two_years >= 1 and mowing_count <= 1 and mowed_area_ha == area_ha and forage_removed

result.description: Mowing obligation is fulfilled.

rules.statement: Grazing is prohibited in principle; after-grazing is permitted annually from 16 August, including in a year without mowing.

result.description: Grazing condition is fulfilled.

rules.statement: Fertilizers, sewage sludge and composted sewage sludge may not be applied. Need-based farmyard manure is the sole exception and may only be applied in its original, not water-dissolved, form; domestic wastewater is allowed.

result.description: Fertilizer condition is fulfilled.

rules.statement: Plant-protection products are prohibited, except products containing exclusively active substances permitted under Regulation (EU) 2018/848.

conditions.description: All used products meet the organic-regulation exception.

result.description: Plant-protection condition is fulfilled.

rules.statement: The measure must be applied for in the multiple-application measures application by 31 December before contract start; the final entry was funding year 2025, applied for by 31 December 2024.

result.description: A contract begins in the following year.

rules.statement: During the measure term, individual or all areas could switch to Naturschutz or Ergebnisorientierte Bewirtschaftung by 31 December 2025.

result.description: No repayment obligation for the original measure follows from this permitted switch.

rules.statement: The parcel use is declared as Bergmähder. In a mowing year declare BM1 for tractor/Mähtrak, BM2 for hand-held motor mower, or BM3 for scythe/motor scythe; in a no-mowing year declare BM0.

conditions.expression: code corresponds to actual mowing method or no mowing

result.description: The annual code represents actual management.

rules.statement: With BM0, all non-mowing obligations remain applicable despite no mowing.

result.description: Grazing, fertilizer and plant-protection restrictions still apply.

rules.statement: Premium is paid only in a mowing year. Rates per hectare are BM1 350 in 2023 and 378 from 2024, BM2 550 in 2023 and 594 from 2024, BM3 900 in 2023 and 972 from 2024; BM0 is 0 from 2023.

conditions.expression: valid mowing-year code and all obligations fulfilled
conditions.description: Payment depends on mowing and compliance.

result.description: Area times applicable method rate.

rules.statement: No other ÖPUL measure premium may be combined on the same Bergmahd parcel, except payment for point landscape elements under UBB or BIO.

result.description: Other parcel-level combinations are not payable.

rules.statement: The applicant must run an agricultural holding in its own name and on its own account, control the applied-for land, and meet active-farmer and agricultural-activity requirements.

result.description: General participation eligibility.

rules.statement: In the first ÖPUL participation year, the farm requires either 0.50 ha protected cultivation or 1.50 ha total qualifying agricultural area; from the second year the general minimum size no longer applies.

result.description: General farm-size admission condition.

rules.statement: Funded land must be located in Austria.

result.description: Foreign land cannot be funded.

rules.statement: For a reduction of multiannual measure area, annual tolerance is up to 5% of prior-year measure area, maximum 5 ha, but 0.50 ha is always allowed; above it, the entire differential area must be repaid, unless another stated exception applies.

result.description: Excess creates repayment for all differential areas.

rules.statement: Bergmahd area additions in 2024 and 2025 are fully payable. In later years, expansions are limited to 50% of 2025 area, although up to 5 ha is always allowed; areas already under the same measure are not an addition.

result.description: Only permitted expansion is premium-eligible.

rules.statement: Substantive management breaches are assessed for severity, extent, duration and frequency; sanction levels range from warning to 100%, with exclusion and recovery after two 100% reductions in the contract term. From 2027, a warning becomes a 1% retention.

result.description: Measure-related sanction and possibly recovery applies.

rules.statement: From 2025 the general maximum for the sum of area-related payments, with stated exclusions, is 1,300 EUR/ha. Farm-size modulation pays 100% through 200 ha, 90% over 200 through 300 ha, 85% over 300 through 1,000 ha and 75% beyond 1,000 ha.

conditions.expression: area_related_payment_sum subject_to_cap and total_farm_area determines modulation bands

result.description: Applicable premium is capped and reduced by the weighted farm-size factor.
